correction.prior_scope: Agency OS experience and bounded editing
correction.current_scope: General surface/component taxonomy and bounded editing rules across SaaS, ecommerce, marketing agencies, and course creators
correction.reason: The contract is reusable across verticals; it defines surfaces, roles, authority, and reuse transitions without designing one concrete product.

purpose: Provide a bounded, replayable mini-vibe editor contract whose permissions are derived from the host seam and reuse shape rather than from donor markup or raw CSS access.

substrates.description: Host-owned surface, slot, route shell, or component released to the editor.
substrates.authority_basis: host contract and declared slot schema

substrates.description: A donor or service rendered inside a declared host wrapper/seam with explicit bridge tokens and release scope.
substrates.authority_basis: declared host seam, bridge token, contract slot, and donor export

substrates.description: An intact application or service whose internal UI, identity, data ownership, and route behavior remain authoritative.

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Use the service as-is behind a host frame and explicit route/identity boundary.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record rights and integration cost; neither is an automatic rejection

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Contain the module behind a host wrapper; edit only declared seams, bridge tokens, and suppression-safe chrome.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record rights, bridge maintenance, and suppression/reimplementation burden

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Transplant a subsystem into host ownership after an explicit seam and token migration.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record migration and maintenance cost; preserve donor provenance

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Extract a bounded, port-compatible UI package into host-owned slots and tokens.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record reimplementation cost and source rights before reuse

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Expose a service capability through a host-owned adapter surface without granting donor UI authority.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record API, adapter, and host seam cost

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Generate host-owned UI from a pattern reference and role contract; the donor pattern has no runtime authority.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record pattern provenance and reimplementation effort

reuse_shape_catalog.description: Instantiate a cross-vertical recipe with controlled roles, tokens, states, and responsive rules.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record template provenance and maintenance cost

reuse_shape_catalog.description: A host-owned, intentionally bespoke deviation recorded as a bounded delta against a recipe.
reuse_shape_catalog.license_and_reimplementation_cost: record delta scope and future maintenance cost

mini_vibe_editor.purpose: Let a user tune released content and composition without granting code, donor-internal, identity, tenant, or arbitrary-coordinate authority.
allowed_operations: choose a registered semantic token or theme mode
reorder children within a released order-independent slot
add a registered role through a declared slot
remove owned content or suppress declared duplicate chrome
replace an owned item with a port-compatible registered role
plan or apply data binding only inside declared release scope
refused_operations: execute arbitrary code or inject raw markup
write raw CSS, arbitrary coordinates, or unregistered tokens
edit donor-internal DOM, state, identity, tenancy, or permissions
create an unregistered slot or route
move a child across a host seam without an upgrade plan
silently drop an operation during donor upgrade or replay
claim a visual score before the controlled screenshot protocol has run
operation_resolution: resolve surface recipe and reuse shape
intersect user intent with declared release scope
resolve semantic role and token binding
apply only if allowed; otherwise return denied, deferred, or escalated with an alternative
replay against upgrade state and block auto-publish for DEGRADED or ORPHANED

owned_ui.effect: replace slot value while preserving semantic role and typography token

embedded_module.condition: declared content slot exposed by the module bridge
embedded_module.effect: replace bridge-released content only; donor-internal copy remains protected

intact_service.constraint: host may edit only host-owned surrounding labels
intact_service.nearest_alternative: use service-authorized content settings or a host wrapper slot

owned_ui.condition: registered semantic token from the active host pack and light/dark mode
owned_ui.effect: resolve host token roles without changing raw donor values

embedded_module.condition: declared bridge token mapping exists for the module seam

intact_service.condition: cross-origin or service-owned variables do not cross the frame boundary
intact_service.constraint: host can theme only its own frame and launcher chrome
intact_service.nearest_alternative: use the service's supported theme setting or preserve the framed surface

owned_ui.condition: children remain within an order-independent released slot
owned_ui.effect: persist semantic order, not pixel coordinates

embedded_module.condition: reorder crosses only declared host seams or module release slots
embedded_module.effect: recompose released units while preserving bridge contracts

intact_service.condition: frame-level route or module placement only; internal order is service-owned
intact_service.effect: reorder framed surfaces in host composition
intact_service.constraint: no internal DOM or workflow reorder
intact_service.nearest_alternative: configure service view order through its own supported controls

owned_ui.condition: slot enumerates a compatible registered role
owned_ui.effect: insert role with responsive, state, and accessibility contract

embedded_module.condition: host wrapper or module release seam accepts the role
embedded_module.effect: insert host-owned wrapper or released module unit

intact_service.effect: add a host wrapper, launcher entry, or framed route
intact_service.nearest_alternative: request or configure the capability in the service

owned_ui.condition: owned content or declared role may be removed without breaking required landmarks
owned_ui.effect: remove role and reflow responsive layout

embedded_module.condition: remove a host-owned released unit or suppress declared duplicate chrome
embedded_module.effect: apply seam-safe suppression and record donor export anchor

intact_service.effect: hide duplicate outer launcher/identity/settings chrome without touching service internals
intact_service.nearest_alternative: retain the service chrome or use its supported configuration

owned_ui.condition: replacement is registered and port-compatible with the released role
owned_ui.effect: replace role while retaining slot, state, token, and responsive contracts

embedded_module.nearest_alternative: replace only within the released port-compatible role set

intact_service.effect: price adapter, transplant, or reimplementation transition
intact_service.nearest_alternative: replace the host frame/route lens, not the service internals

owned_ui.condition: binding is inside declared release scope with a typed semantic role
owned_ui.effect: bind fixture or approved domain data and preserve loading/error/denied states

embedded_module.condition: adapter bridge explicitly releases the binding and its failure states
embedded_module.effect: bind through adapter contract without donor-private data access

intact_service.condition: service data owner and permissions remain authoritative
intact_service.effect: no host binding into internal service records
intact_service.constraint: no tenant, identity, or permission bypass
intact_service.nearest_alternative: use the service API/adapter or host-owned synthetic summary surface

anchor_classes.meaning: named released insertion or content slot
controlled component role with token, state, responsive, and accessibility obligations
declared composition boundary owned by the host
explicit donor release point; creates upgrade debt and replay obligation

outcome_contract.allowed: apply the operation and persist intent, resolution, and receipt
outcome_contract.denied: do not apply; return the violated authority constraint and nearest allowed alternative
outcome_contract.deferred: do not apply yet; identify the missing declaration, permission, or fixture and preserve the operation intent
outcome_contract.escalated: do not auto-apply; create a priced composition, transplant, adapter, or reimplementation transition

rules: RESOLVED may replay only after anchors and permissions resolve.
DEGRADED must remain visible and block auto-publish until an operator resolves the missing anchor or accepts a new contract.
ORPHANED must not be silently dropped; return escalation or a user-visible refusal with a reimplementation path.
A changed donor anchor cannot be replaced by a coordinate guess.

channel_policy.rule: All channels resolve through the same authority matrix and refusal contract.
channel_policy.least_bounded_channel_rule: Natural language never expands authority; unresolved intent is deferred or denied.

allowed: select a registered host semantic role
select light/dark mode through host resolution
use context offset only when the token contract declares it
refused: invert a donor palette by arbitrary filter
write raw donor CSS values as a theme contract
cross a B5 service boundary with implicit variables
treat raw 21st.dev tags as token or authority roles

visual_gate_policy.product_surface_reuse: UI quality is a gate and must use the Value Matrix visual score contract.
visual_gate_policy.engine_or_pattern_reuse: UI quality is NOT_APPLICABLE; continue capability, rights, runtime, maintenance, and authority gates.

observed_reimplementation_cost_bands.interpretation: subsystem absorption and host seam work

rights_and_cost.rule: Cost and rights are recorded as Value Matrix evidence and transition pricing; neither substitutes for the visual gate nor automatically rejects a useful engine or pattern.

invariants: Exactly 7 verbs and 3 substrates yield 21 authority cells.
Every matrix cell has one decision from the decision vocabulary.
A denied cell has a constraint and nearest allowed alternative.
An escalated cell has a contract transition and nearest allowed alternative.
No operation grants new authority; scope is intent intersected with released scope.
Coordinates and donor-internal selectors are never anchors.
Intact service identity, tenancy, permissions, internal theme, internal text, and internal data remain protected.
DEGRADED and ORPHANED upgrade states block auto-publish.
UI quality gates product-surface reuse but is NOT_APPLICABLE to engine and pattern reuse.
The contract does not select or define one concrete product.
